en: A black and white vintage postcard depicting a grand, ornate building with a domed corner in a bustling city street. The street has horse-drawn carriages and pedestrians, evoking an early 20th-century European urban scene. The text at the top reads 'VIGO.' and 'Calle de Policarpo Sanz.' There is also a round library stamp in Spanish and additional property marks indicating a public library collection.
